title: Decoupling Logic from Persona: Structural Immunity of Edge LLM Agents to Context Pollution
title_zh: 将逻辑与角色解耦：边缘 LLM 智能体对上下文污染的结构免疫性

paragraphs.en: Small language-model agents that run on edge devices are expected to hold a persona and to reason correctly at the same time, inside one context window that fills with conversational history and persona instructions. We study what happens to the logical part of such an agent when that history is long, misleading and persona-heavy, a failure mode we call persona–logic interference , and we present a Decoupling Architecture (AO-DA) that separates logical inference (“What”) from persona expression (“How”) into two inference paths on one INT4-quantized base model with hot-swappable LoRA adapters. The logic path receives only the core turn, emits a verifiable structured state (a Micro-State ), and the persona path renders that state in character while receiving the full history. In same-base-model ablations on consumer edge hardware (Apple M2, 24 GB; Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Gemma-3-4B-it, both 4-bit; 480 runs over 4 pollution levels × 3 arms × 2 tasks × 2 personas × 5 seeds) we find three things. (i) The decoupled logic path is structurally invariant to pollution: its prompt stays at 180 tokens (Llama) or 167 tokens (Gemma) while the mixed single-pass prompt grows from 242 to 1,203 tokens, and its outputs are byte-identical across all pollution levels (40/40 pairs). (ii) The mixed single-pass configuration degrades monotonically (composite logic score 0.669 → 0.150 on Llama, 0.487 → 0.150 on Gemma; Spearman ρ = −0.74 and −0.69), and most of this collapse is a failure to produce the required structured output (80–95% empty structures on Llama, 100% on Gemma at the two highest levels); scored on raw text the degradation is smaller but still present (0.78 → 0.38 on Llama). (iii) When the same pollution is deliberately fed into the decoupled logic path, the dedicated-adapter, dedicated-format path is still more robust than the single pass on the 8B model (structured-output failure 0–20% vs 80–95%; paired Δ in composite score +0.30 to +0.50, Cliff’s δ 0.50–0.85, Holm-adjusted p ≤ 0.03), but not on the 4B model, where both collapse. Separation costs one extra decode on the first turn of a topic (28.2 s vs 18.2 s on Llama) and buys persona hot-swapping in 1.7 ms (median, warm) without re-running the logic path, with memory fixed at a single resident base (≈4.3 GB active, ≈5 GB peak for the 8B model).
paragraphs.zh: 在边缘设备上运行的小型语言模型智能体，需要在同一个上下文窗口内同时保持角色设定并正确推理，而该窗口会填充对话历史和角色设定说明。 我们研究了当对话历史冗长、具有误导性且充满角色设定信息时，此类智能体的逻辑部分会发生什么变化——我们将这种失效模式称为“角色–逻辑干扰”，并提出了一种解耦架构（AO-DA），它将逻辑推理（“内容”）与角色表达（“方式”）分离为两条推理路径，共享一个经过 INT4 量化的基础模型，并支持热替换的 LoRA 适配器。 逻辑路径仅接收核心对话回合，并输出一个可验证的结构化状态（微状态），而角色路径则在接收完整对话历史的同时，以特定角色身份呈现该状态。 在消费级边缘硬件（Apple M2，24 GB；Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Gemma-3-4B-it，均为 4-bit；共 480 次运行，覆盖 4 种污染水平 × 3 种实验臂 × 2 种任务 × 2 种角色 × 5 种随机种子）上进行的同模型消融实验中，我们发现了三个结果。 （i）解耦后的逻辑路径在结构上对污染具有不变性：其提示长度固定为 180 个词元（Llama）或 167 个词元（Gemma），而混合单遍处理的提示长度则从 242 增长到 1,203 个词元；在所有污染水平下，其输出字节完全一致（40/40 对）。 （ii）混合单遍处理配置的性能呈单调下降趋势（Llama 上的综合逻辑得分从 0.669 降至 0.150，Gemma 上从 0.487 降至 0.150；Spearman ρ = −0.74 和 −0.69），且这种性能崩溃主要源于无法生成所需结构化输出（Llama 在最高两个污染水平下，80–95% 的结构为空；Gemma 则全部为空）；若仅基于原始文本评分，性能下降幅度较小但仍显著存在（Llama 上从 0.78 降至 0.38）。 （iii）当将相同程度的污染数据故意输入解耦逻辑路径时，使用专用适配器和专用格式的路径在 8B 模型上仍比单遍处理更稳健（结构化输出失败率：0–20% vs 80–95%；配对综合得分差异为 +0.30 至 +0.50，Cliff’s δ 为 0.50–0.85，经 Holm 校正的 p ≤ 0.03），但在 4B 模型上两者均会崩溃。 这种分离机制在话题的首个回合中需要一次额外的解码（Llama 上耗时 28.2 秒 vs 18.2 秒），但实现了角色设定的热替换，仅需 1.7 毫秒（中位数，暖启动状态），且无需重新运行逻辑路径；内存占用则固定为单个常驻基础模型（8B 模型约 4.3 GB 活跃内存，约 5 GB 峰值内存）。

paragraphs.en: An edge agent that speaks as a character and advises on a task carries two jobs in one context window. The persona job wants history: tone, running jokes, what was said three turns ago. The logic job wants the opposite: a clean statement of the current state and the rules that apply to it. When both jobs share one prompt, the history that helps the first job becomes noise, or worse, misleading evidence, for the second. Long and distracting contexts are known to hurt reasoning in large models (Liu et al. 2024; Shi et al. 2023; Levy, Jacoby, and Goldberg 2024); persona prompts are known to shift or bias reasoning (Gupta et al. 2024; Zheng et al. 2024); and multi-turn conversations degrade performance even in frontier models (Laban et al. 2025). On a 4–8B model quantized to 4 bits and running on a laptop, all three effects arrive at once.
paragraphs.zh: 一个以角色身份发言并为任务提供建议的边缘智能体，在同一个上下文窗口中同时承担两项任务。 角色任务需要历史信息：语气、持续的笑话，以及三轮对话前所说的内容。 逻辑任务则需要相反的信息：当前状态的清晰描述以及适用于该状态的所有规则。 当这两项任务共享同一个提示时，有助于第一项任务的历史信息对于第二项任务而言就会变成噪声，甚至更糟，成为误导性证据。 已知冗长且分散注意力的上下文会损害大型模型的推理能力（Liu et al. 2024; Shi et al. 2023; Levy, Jacoby, and Goldberg 2024）；角色提示已知会改变或影响推理的偏向性（Gupta et al. 2024; Zheng et al. 2024）；而多轮对话即使在前沿模型中也会降低性能（Laban et al. 2025）。 在一个量化到 4 位并运行于笔记本电脑上的 4–8B 模型上，这三种影响会同时出现。

paragraphs.en: We call the resulting degradation persona–logic interference : the loss of task-logic quality that occurs when persona expression and logical inference compete inside one accumulating context. We deliberately avoid the term “alignment tax”, which in the literature denotes capability lost through alignment training (Askell et al. 2021; Ouyang et al. 2022); the effect studied here is architectural, not a property of training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将由此产生的退化称为“人格–逻辑干扰”：即当人格表达与逻辑推理在同一个不断累积的上下文中相互竞争时，任务逻辑质量随之下降的现象。 我们刻意避免使用“对齐成本”这一术语，因为在相关文献中，该术语指代通过对齐训练所导致的能力损失（Askell et al. 2021; Ouyang et al. 2022）；而本文研究的影响属于架构层面的问题，而非训练特性。

paragraphs.en: Our proposal is to stop sharing the context. The Decoupling Architecture (AO-DA) runs two inference paths on the same quantized base model: a What path that carries a task-logic adapter, receives only the core turn and the observable signals (vitals, profile, intent), and emits a compact, schema-checked Micro-State ; and a How path that carries a persona adapter, receives the Micro-State together with the full conversation history, and renders the reply in character. The two paths never share a context window. Because the What path’s input is bounded by construction, its output cannot be polluted by history, however long or misleading the history is. This paper reports what that buys, what it costs, and what remains open.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的提议是停止共享上下文。 解耦架构（AO-DA）在同一个量化基础模型上运行两条推理路径：一条“是什么”路径，它携带任务逻辑适配器，仅接收核心轮次和可观察信号（生命体征、个人资料、意图），并输出一个经过模式校验的紧凑微状态；另一条“怎么做”路径，它携带角色适配器，接收微状态以及完整的对话历史，并以角色身份生成回复。 这两条路径绝不会共享上下文窗口。 由于“是什么”路径的输入在设计上受到限制，因此无论对话历史有多长或具有误导性，其输出都不会被历史内容污染。 本文报告了这种做法带来的收益、付出的代价以及尚未解决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Characterization of the single-pass collapse. Under misleading, persona-heavy history the mixed configuration’s composite logic score falls monotonically to the scoring floor on both bases. We decompose the collapse and show that most of it is a failure to produce the required structured output (80–95% of runs on Llama, 100% on Gemma at the two highest levels), with a smaller but real loss in the raw-text content.
paragraphs.zh: 单次通过坍缩的特性分析。 在具有误导性且充满角色设定历史的情况下，混合配置的综合逻辑分数在两种基准上都会单调下降至评分下限。 我们对这种坍缩进行了分解，并发现其大部分原因是未能生成所需的结构化输出（Llama 模型中 80%–95% 的运行出现此问题，Gemma 模型在两个最高级别上则全部出现），同时原始文本内容也存在较小但实际存在的损失。

sents.en: Characterization of the single-pass collapse.
sents.zh: 单次通过坍缩的特性分析。

sents.en: Under misleading, persona-heavy history the mixed configuration’s composite logic score falls monotonically to the scoring floor on both bases.
sents.zh: 在具有误导性且充满角色设定历史的情况下，混合配置的综合逻辑分数在两种基准上都会单调下降至评分下限。

sents.en: We decompose the collapse and show that most of it is a failure to produce the required structured output (80–95% of runs on Llama, 100% on Gemma at the two highest levels), with a smaller but real loss in the raw-text content.
sents.zh: 我们对这种坍缩进行了分解，并发现其大部分原因是未能生成所需的结构化输出（Llama 模型中 80%–95% 的运行出现此问题，Gemma 模型在两个最高级别上则全部出现），同时原始文本内容也存在较小但实际存在的损失。

paragraphs.en: Empirical robustness of the two-stage logic path under the same pollution. When the history is deliberately routed into the What path (an ablation that the architecture forbids), the dedicated-adapter, dedicated-format path still fails far less often than the single pass on the 8B model (0–20% vs 80–95%) and scores higher on every polluted level (paired Δ +0.30 to +0.50 in composite score). On the 4B model it collapses like the single pass. This bounds the mechanism: separation protects by not routing history to the logic path; the adapter and output format alone add robustness on the larger base only.
paragraphs.zh: 在相同污染条件下，两阶段逻辑路径的经验鲁棒性。 当历史数据被刻意引导至“What”路径（一种架构所禁止的消融测试）时，专用适配器与专用格式路径的失败频率仍远低于 8B 模型上的单通处理（0–20% 对比 80–95%），并且在所有污染等级下的得分均更高（复合分数的配对 Δ 为 +0.30 至 +0.50）。 在 4B 模型上，其表现如同单通处理一样崩溃。 这限定了该机制：分离性通过避免将历史数据引导至逻辑路径来实现保护；而仅靠适配器和输出格式则只能在更大的基础模型上增强鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: Long and distracting context. Liu et al. (Liu et al. 2024) showed that language models use information in the middle of long contexts poorly; Shi et al. (Shi et al. 2023) showed that irrelevant context alone degrades arithmetic reasoning; Levy et al. (Levy, Jacoby, and Goldberg 2024) showed that reasoning degrades with input length well before the context limit, even when the extra tokens are padding; RULER (Hsieh et al. 2024) showed that effective context size is far below the advertised one. Laban et al. (Laban et al. 2025) found that frontier models lose roughly 39% of their performance when a task is delivered across turns rather than at once. Our pollution levels are built from exactly these ingredients, history, length and system-prompt bloat, but on 4-bit 4–8B models and with history that is misleading rather than merely irrelevant.
paragraphs.zh: 冗长且分散注意力的上下文。Liu 等人 （Liu 等人，2024）表明，语言模型对长上下文中中间部分的信息利用效率低下；Shi 等人 （Shi 等人，2023）表明，仅无关的上下文就会削弱算术推理能力；Levy 等人 （Levy、Jacoby 和 Goldberg，2024）表明，即使额外添加的标记仅为填充内容，推理能力在达到上下文限制之前就已随输入长度的增加而下降；RULER（Hsieh 等人，2024）表明，有效上下文大小远低于官方宣称的大小。Laban 等人 （Laban 等人，2025）发现，当任务分多个回合传递而非一次性提供时，前沿模型的性能会下降约 39%。 我们的污染水平正是由这些要素构成的：历史、长度以及系统提示的冗余内容，但研究对象是 4-bit 的 4–8B 模型，且其历史信息具有误导性，而不仅仅是无关紧要。

paragraphs.en: Persona and role prompts. Role prompting can help zero-shot reasoning (Kong et al. 2024), but personas in system prompts do not reliably improve performance (Zheng et al. 2024) and introduce implicit reasoning biases (Gupta et al. 2024). Shanahan et al. (Shanahan, McDonell, and Reynolds 2023) frame LLM dialogue as role play; Character-LLM (Shao et al. 2023) trains persona agents by fine-tuning. Models are also sycophantic toward prior assistant statements (Sharma et al. 2023), which is why a history in which the assistant previously endorsed a bad action is a particularly effective pollutant. AO-DA does not try to make the persona path reason better; it removes the persona from the path that reasons.
paragraphs.zh: 人格与角色提示。 角色提示有助于零样本推理（Kong 等人，2024），但系统提示中的人格设定并不能稳定提升性能（Zheng 等人，2024），反而会引入隐性的推理偏见（Gupta 等人，2024）。Shanahan 等人 （Shanahan、McDonell 和 Reynolds，2023）将大语言模型对话视为角色扮演；Character-LLM（Shao 等人，2023）通过微调训练人格智能体。 模型还会对先前助手陈述的内容表现出阿谀奉承（Sharma 等人，2023），因此，在历史记录中助手此前认可了错误行为的情况，会构成一种特别有效的污染因素。 AO-DA 并不试图让人格路径的推理更优；它只是从推理路径中移除人格设定。

paragraphs.en: Multi-adapter serving. LoRA (Hu et al. 2022) makes task- and persona-specific behaviour a few-megabyte delta on a shared base; S-LoRA (Sheng et al. 2024) and Punica (Chen et al. 2024) serve thousands of adapters on one base in the data centre. AO-DA applies the same idea at the other end of the scale, a single 4-bit base resident in unified memory with two adapters swapped in milliseconds, on top of 4-bit weight quantization (Frantar et al. 2023; Lin et al. 2024) and the MLX runtime (Hannun et al. 2023).
paragraphs.zh: 多适配器服务。 LoRA（Hu 等人，2022）使任务和角色特定的行为在共享基模型上仅产生数兆字节的增量；S-LoRA（Sheng 等人，2024）和 Punica（Chen 等人，2024）可在数据中心的一个基模型上运行数千个适配器。 AO-DA 将同样的理念应用于该规模的另一端：一个位于统一内存中的单个 4 位基模型，配合两个可在毫秒内切换的适配器，并在此基础上实现了 4 位权重量化（Frantar 等人，2023；Lin 等人，2024）以及 MLX 运行时（Hannun 等人，2023）。

paragraphs.en: Separating reasoning from verbalization. Chain-of-thought (Wei et al. 2022) and plan-and-solve prompting (Wang et al. 2023) separate reasoning from the answer within one generation; ReAct (Yao et al. 2023) interleaves reasoning and acting. AO-DA separates them across generations, with a verifiable intermediate object, so that the second generation can be re-run (new persona) or skipped (cache hit) without touching the first.
paragraphs.zh: 将推理与语言化分离。 思维链（Wei et al. 2022）和“计划-解决”提示方法（Wang et al. 2023）在单次生成中就将推理与答案分离；而 ReAct（Yao et al. 2023）则将推理与行动交替进行。 AO-DA 将二者分置于不同生成阶段，并引入一个可验证的中间对象，因此第二次生成可以重新运行（使用新角色）或跳过（缓存命中），而无需改动第一次生成的结果。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows the data flow. A turn arrives as a core user utterance plus observable signals (a profile type, a vitals snapshot, a session intent bucket). The What path builds a prompt from a fixed system header, the vitals and the core utterance only; it runs on the base model with the task-logic adapter (the Mental Coach LoRA in our experiments) and emits a tagged assessment: a short thought and a JSON object with two fields, s (user state) and a (recommended action). The size of this prompt does not depend on how long the conversation has been. The How path builds its prompt from the persona system header, a compressed instruction derived from the Micro-State, the list of constraints the reply must mention, the risk level, and then the conversation history and the user’s full (possibly long) utterance; it runs on the same base with the persona adapter and emits a single JSON field t , the spoken line. The two prompts are assembled independently; neither path sees the other’s context.

paragraphs.en: The Micro-State (schema v1.1, Appendix C) is the only object that crosses from What to How. It carries the inputs that produced it, an inference record with provenance, a prioritized list of constraints (actions the reply must mention), a risk level, a render plan (order of mentions, forbidden additions, required mentions), a cache key, and the parsed What output. In the released testbed, the constraints and risk for the two benchmark tasks are derived by a deterministic policy layer from the vitals and the session intent (e.g., low recovery with caffeine intent ⇒ {prohibit caffeine, 20-minute nap, cold water}); the What model’s free text populates the inference and parsed fields and is used as the instruction only when no rule fires. This matters for interpreting the How-side results (§5.6–5.7) and we return to it there.

paragraphs.en: Both adapters are LoRA deltas on the same 4-bit base. The base is loaded once into unified memory; switching between What, Goku and Makima is an in-place update of the adapter weights, not a model reload. Memory therefore does not grow with the number of personas (§6.2). A persona switch that does not change the state (a “second opinion” from another character) is served from the Micro-State cache: the How path is re-run with the new adapter and the What path is not invoked at all (§6.1).
paragraphs.zh: 两个适配器都是基于同一个 4 位基础模型生成的 LoRA 增量。 该基础模型会被一次性加载到统一内存中；在 What、Goku 和 Makima 之间切换时，只需原地更新适配器权重，而无需重新加载模型。 因此，内存不会随着人格数量的增加而增长（§6.2）。 如果人格切换不改变状态（即另一个角色提供的“第二意见”），则会从微状态缓存中提供服务：How 路径会使用新的适配器重新运行，而 What 路径则完全不会被调用（§6.1）。

paragraphs.en: The cache key is a hash of the observable signals (profile type, recovery percentage, fatigue band, domain, intent bucket, schema version). Routing, which persona, which logic adapter, is done by a deterministic policy router over the same signals plus a dictionary of lexical cues; it runs in microseconds and, in the one run where we compared it against an LLM classifier, returned the same decision (§6.3). The router is not needed for the ablations in §5, where the arm is fixed by design.
paragraphs.zh: 缓存键是可观测量信号（个人资料类型、恢复百分比、疲劳带、领域、意图桶、模式版本）的哈希值。 如果人格切换时信号未发生变化，则会命中缓存；若生命体征发生变化或用户进行显式覆盖，则无法命中缓存，并将重新运行“What”路径，生成具有新约束条件的新状态（§6.1）。 路由决策（选择哪个人格、哪个逻辑适配器）由一个确定性策略路由器基于相同的信号以及一个词汇线索词典完成；该过程在微秒级内执行，在我们唯一一次将其与 LLM 分类器进行比较的运行中，它得出了相同的决策（§6.3）。 在 §5 的消融实验中不需要路由器，因为其中分支是经由设计固定的。

paragraphs.en: L1 (long input only) was defined in the plan but not run. The history fixtures (Appendix D) are the important part: they are not neutral filler. The sleep-domain history has the assistant previously tolerating “one energy drink” in a hype tone and the user announcing that they will “chug multiple energy drinks anyway”; the legal-domain history mixes token-promotion pressure with compliance warnings. Both contain some gold-consistent statements as well (e.g., “nap twenty, ice water”), which matters for one result in §5.4. The long input is a repetitive, anxious user stream with distractor numbers; the system bloat is seven persona-voiced few-shot replies.

paragraphs.en: Two tasks with objectively checkable logic (Appendix E): align_sleep_pitch (recovery 42%, high fatigue, sympathetic dominance; the user plans three energy drinks before an investor pitch; gold: prohibit caffeine, 20-minute nap, cold water; concepts: recovery, sleep; forbidden: heart-rate figures, diagnosis, cardiologist) and align_legal_token (the user asks whether their token structure creates US securities exposure; gold: halt promotion pending legal review, seek qualified securities counsel, disclose exposure risk; concepts: securities, token; forbidden: the sleep-task actions). paragraphs.en: Composite logic score (primary). From the What output (for G0, the single output) we parse the thought and the s / a fields and score the concatenation: 0.6 × required-action coverage + 0.25 × required-concept hit rate + 0.15 × (1 − forbidden-term hit rate). An output with no parseable thought, s or a scores 0.15 (the forbidden term is trivially avoided), which is the floor seen in the figures. Matching is keyword-based with a deliberately loose synonym dictionary (Appendix E); no LLM judge was used. The composite score of every run was recomputed from the raw outputs for this paper and agrees with the logged value to within 1e-6.

paragraphs.en: The study was planned in June 2026 (v2 plan, Appendix F) with 30–50 diverse tasks, three bases and a statistical test of persona invariance (H3). What was run: 2 tasks, 2 bases, 2 personas, 5 seeds, and L1 omitted. H3 is reported descriptively (§5.6) because the decoupled What output is identical across personas by construction, which leaves nothing to test. Run 1, the low-pollution battery that preceded Run 1b, is reported first (§5.1) because its null result is a boundary condition for everything after it.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究计划于2026年6月实施（v2计划，附录F），包括30至50项多样化任务、三个基地以及对人格不变性的统计检验（H3）。 实际运行内容：2项任务、2个基地、2种人格、5个种子，且省略了L1。 H3以描述性方式报告（§5.6），因为根据设计，解耦后的“What”输出在所有人格中完全相同，因此没有可检验的内容。 运行1（即运行1b之前的低污染电池测试）被优先报告（§5.1），因为其零结果构成了后续所有研究的一个边界条件。

paragraphs.en: Paired comparisons (n = 20 per cell) use the Wilcoxon signed-rank test (two-sided, zero differences dropped), Cliff’s δ as effect size, and a bootstrap 95% CI of the mean paired difference (10,000 resamples). The main family is G3-P vs G0 at each level and base (8 tests); G3 vs G0 is reported as a reference family (since G3 is constant across levels, it is a test of G0’s degradation). Holm correction is applied within each family. Failure rates carry Wilson 95% CIs and are compared with Fisher’s exact test. Monotone degradation is tested with Spearman’s ρ between the level ordinal and the per-run score. No test is applied to the stability of G3 across levels.
paragraphs.zh: 配对比较（每格 n = 20）采用威尔科克森符号秩检验（双侧，排除差异为零的情况）、Cliff’s δ 作为效应量，以及配对差异均值的自助 95% 置信区间（10,000 次重采样）。 在每个水平和基线上，主要比较族为 G3-P 与 G0（8 项检验）；G3 与 G0 的对比作为参考比较族报告（由于 G3 在所有水平上保持不变，因此该检验用于评估 G0 的退化情况）。 在每个比较族内应用 Holm 校正。 失效率附带威尔逊 95% 置信区间，并通过费希尔精确检验进行比较。 通过水平序数与每次运行得分之间的斯皮尔曼 ρ 值来检验单调退化。 未对 G3 在不同水平上的稳定性进行任何检验。

paragraphs.en: Run 1 (3 June 2026; Llama only; three tasks including a second-opinion variant; G0, G3, G4 = G3 with a constraint-echo instruction on the How path; and a probe that puts the persona adapter on the What path) is the boundary condition. With short, clean prompts the composite logic score of the decoupled What path is indistinguishable from the single pass (Δ = -0.004 [95% CI -0.091, +0.082], Cliff’s δ = -0.02, Wilcoxon p = 0.98), while How constraint coverage is higher for the decoupled arms (Δ = +0.256 [95% CI +0.111, +0.400], Cliff’s δ = +0.39, p = <0.001). Putting the persona adapter on the logic path lowered the score but not significantly (Δ = -0.059 [95% CI -0.138, +0.015], p = 0.20).
paragraphs.zh: 运行 1（2026 年 6 月 3 日；仅使用 Llama；包含一个第二意见变体的三项任务；G0、G3、G4 = G3 在“如何”路径上附加了约束回响指令；以及一个将角色适配器置于“什么”路径上的探针）是边界条件。 在简短清晰的提示下，解耦的“什么”路径的复合逻辑得分与单次处理无显著差异（Δ = -0.004 [95% CI -0.091, +0.082]，Cliff’s δ = -0.02，Wilcoxon p = 0.98），而“如何”路径的约束覆盖范围在解耦分支中更高（Δ = +0.256 [95% CI +0.111, +0.400]，Cliff’s δ = +0.39，p = <0.001）。 将角色适配器置于逻辑路径上降低了得分，但差异不显著（Δ = -0.059 [95% CI -0.138, +0.015]，p = 0.20）。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 and Figure 2 give the primary result. The mixed single pass degrades monotonically on both bases (Spearman ρ between level and per-run score: −0.74 for Llama, −0.69 for Gemma, both p < 0.001) and reaches the 0.15 floor at L4 (Llama) and L3 (Gemma). The decoupled logic path is constant at 0.655 (Llama) and 0.695 (Gemma) at every level; this is not a statistical stability but an identity (§5.5). The logic-polluted ablation G3-P stays well above G0 on Llama at every polluted level (0.798, 0.515, 0.650 vs 0.450, 0.219, 0.150) and collapses with G0 on Gemma.
paragraphs.zh: 表1和图2给出了主要结果。 混合单次通过方法在两种基线模型上均呈现单调下降趋势（Spearman ρ 值：Llama 为 −0.74，Gemma 为 −0.69，两者均 p < 0.001），并在 L4（Llama）和 L3（Gemma）时达到 0.15 的下限。 解耦的逻辑路径在所有层级上保持恒定，Llama 为 0.655，Gemma 为 0.695；这并非统计稳定性，而是一种恒等关系（§5.5）。 在受逻辑污染的消融实验中，G3-P 在 Llama 的所有污染层级上都显著高于 G0（0.798、0.515、0.650 对比 0.450、0.219、0.150），而在 Gemma 上则与 G0 一同崩溃。

paragraphs.en: Two details in Table 1 deserve attention. First, on Gemma the decoupled logic path scores higher than the single pass already at L0 (0.695 vs 0.487, paired Δ +0.207 [+0.10, +0.31], Holm p = 0.007): on the smaller model the persona overlay alone, with no history, already costs logic. paragraphs.en: On Llama the single pass fails to produce structure in 25% of runs at L2, 80% at L3 and 95% at L4 (0% at L0; Fisher L0 vs L3 and L0 vs L4 both p < 0.001). On Gemma it fails in 85%, 100% and 100% (5% at L0). The decoupled, clean logic path never fails (0/20 at every level on both bases). What the models produce instead of the schema is persona-voiced prose, typically continuing the history’s tone; the thought tag is often present but the JSON block is missing or malformed.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Llama 上，单次处理在 L2 时 25% 的运行未能生成结构，L3 时为 80%，L4 时为 95%（L0 时为 0%；Fisher 检验显示 L0 与 L3、L0 与 L4 的对比均满足 p < 0.001）。 在 Gemma 上，失败率分别为 85%、100% 和 100%（L0 时为 5%）。 解耦后的清晰逻辑路径从未失败（在所有层级上，两种基础模型均未出现失败，即 0/20）。 模型生成内容并非 schema，而是以角色口吻书写的散文，通常会延续历史文本的语调；思维标签通常存在，但 JSON 块缺失或格式错误。

paragraphs.zh: 根据原始文本得分，性能下降幅度较小，但仍呈单调递减趋势（Llama：0.78 → 0.71 → 0.33 → 0.38，Spearman ρ = −0.56；Gemma：0.73 → 0.69 → 0.51 → 0.47，ρ = −0.53；两者 p < 0.001）。 因此，这种崩溃是两种现象叠加的结果：在 8B 模型上，格式合规性几乎完全丧失，逻辑内容也大致减半。 摘要中的综合得分（0.669 → 0.150）应始终与旁边的两个数值一同解读。

paragraphs.en: On Llama the two-stage path is more robust at every polluted level: Δ = +0.35 (L2), +0.30 (L3), +0.50 (L4), Cliff’s δ = 0.72, 0.50, 0.85, Holm-adjusted p = 0.003, 0.028, 0.001. Its structured-output failure rate is 0%, 20% and 15% against 25%, 80% and 95% (Fisher, Holm p ≤ 0.001 at L3 and L4). On Gemma there is no difference at L2–L4: both arms fail to produce structure in ≥ 85% of runs and sit at the floor. The 4B model’s format compliance does not survive the history whichever adapter is active; only the input bound saves it.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Llama 上，两阶段路径在所有污染水平下都更具鲁棒性：Δ = +0.35（L2）、+0.30（L3）、+0.50（L4），Cliff 的 δ = 0.72、0.50、0.85，Holm 调整后的 p = 0.003、0.028、0.001。 其结构化输出失败率分别为 0%、20% 和 15%，而另一组则为 25%、80% 和 95%（在 L3 和 L4 上，Fisher 和 Holm 的 p ≤ 0.001）。 在 Gemma 上，L2–L4 之间没有差异：两条路径在所有运行中至少有 85% 的情况都无法生成结构，且均处于最低水平。 无论哪个适配器处于激活状态，该 4B 模型都无法保持格式合规性；只有输入边界能使其免于失败。

paragraphs.en: On raw text the picture is more nuanced. At L0, with no pollution, the single pass scores higher on raw text on Llama (0.78 vs 0.66, Holm p = 0.043), because its longer, persona-voiced output mentions more of the keywords in free text; the composite score, which ignores free text, does not show this. paragraphs.en: Table 4 shows why the clean logic path cannot degrade. Its prompt is 179–181 tokens on Llama and 165–169 on Gemma at every level; the single-pass prompt is 242, 562, 1,014 and 1,203 tokens (Llama) and 231, 551, 1,051 and 1,251 (Gemma). The What outputs of G3 are byte-identical across L0, L2, L3 and L4 for every (task, persona, seed) triple on both bases (20/20 triples each, 40/40 in total). Identical input plus fixed seed gives identical output; there is no stochastic stability to test. The persona-path prompt, by contrast, grows with the pollution exactly as the single pass does (312 → 1,273 tokens on Llama), which is where the How-side degradation in §5.6 comes from.
paragraphs.zh: 表4说明了为何干净的逻辑路径不会退化。 在每个层级上，其提示在 Llama 上为 179–181 个词元，在 Gemma 上为 165–169 个词元；单次通过的提示分别为 242、562、1,014 和 1,203 个词元（Llama），以及 231、551、1,051 和 1,251 个词元（Gemma）。 对于两种基础模型上的每个（任务、角色、种子）三元组，G3 的“是什么”输出在 L0、L2、L3 和 L4 上完全字节一致（每种基础模型各 20/20 个三元组，总计 40/40）。 相同的输入加上固定的种子会产生相同的输出；因此没有随机稳定性需要测试。 相比之下，角色路径提示会随着污染程度增加而增长，与单次通过提示的增长方式完全一致（在 Llama 上从 312 增至 1,273 个词元），这正是 §5.6 中“如何”侧退化现象的根源。

paragraphs.en: Latency is the cost side. On Llama at L0 the decoupled turn takes 28.2 s against 18.2 s for the single pass, because it decodes twice; the What stage is 11.8–12.9 s at every level (its input never grows), and the How stage is 9.4–16.4 s. paragraphs.en: On the How side, two caveats must come before the numbers. First, in the released testbed the Micro-State constraints for both tasks are produced by the deterministic policy layer, not by the What model’s free text (§3.2); as a result the How prompts of G3 and G3-P are identical and so are their spoken outputs, byte for byte, in all 60 pairs on each base. The How-side results therefore measure how faithfully the persona path renders a fixed Micro-State under pollution; they do not measure propagation of What-model errors into speech. Second, the G3 How prompt lists the required constraints explicitly (that is what the Micro-State is for), whereas G0 is asked to derive and mention “all applicable constraints” on its own. The How comparison is an end-to-end comparison of two pipelines with different information, not an equal-information test.

paragraphs.en: The following were measured on the Llama-3.1-8B 4-bit base in the June 2026 verification turns and in a Phase 3 prototype capture; they are single-run or few-run measurements and are reported as such.
paragraphs.zh: 以下数据是在 2026 年 6 月的验证轮次以及第 3 阶段原型捕获中，基于 Llama-3.1-8B 4-bit 基础模型测得的；这些数据为单次运行或少次运行的测量结果，并以此身份报告。

paragraphs.en: In nine “second opinion” turns (Turn 2-A: the user asks Makima to comment on Goku’s advice, vitals unchanged), the Goku → Makima adapter swap took 53.9 ms on the first call (adapter weights not yet warm) and 1.41–2.15 ms on the next eight (median 1.70 ms). In all nine turns the Micro-State cache hit ( cache_hit = true , JSON hash identical to Turn 1-A, what_path_invocations = 0 ): the logic path was not re-run, and the turn cost only the How decode (median 7.1 s, range 5.9–13.1 s). When vitals changed between turns (Turn 2-B, recovery 42% → 58%), the cache missed in 8/8 runs and the What path was re-invoked, producing a new state with the relaxed constraint set (“limit caffeine to one unit” instead of “prohibit”); when the user overrode the advice (Turn 2-C), the cache missed in 2/2 runs and the new state carried an escalation constraint. Reuse and invalidation behaved as designed in every logged case.
paragraphs.zh: 在九次“第二意见”轮次中（第 2-A 轮：用户要求 Makima 对悟空的建议发表评论，生命体征未变），悟空 → Makima 适配器切换在首次调用时耗时 53.9 毫秒（此时适配器权重尚未预热），随后八次调用则分别耗时 1.41–2.15 毫秒（中位数为 1.70 毫秒）。 在所有九轮次中，Micro-State 缓存均命中（cache_hit = true，JSON 哈希与第 1-A 轮相同，what_path_invocations = 0）：逻辑路径未被重新执行，该轮次仅消耗“如何解码”步骤的时间（中位数为 7.1 秒，范围 5.9–13.1 秒）。 当轮次间生命体征发生变化时（第 2-B 轮，恢复率从 42% 变为 58%），8/8 次运行均发生缓存未命中，且“What”路径被重新调用，生成一个带有放宽约束集的新状态（将“限制咖啡因摄入至一个单位”替代“禁止”）；当用户覆盖建议时（第 2-C 轮），2/2 次运行均发生缓存未命中，且新状态附带了一个升级约束。 在所有记录案例中，重用与失效行为均符合设计预期。

paragraphs.en: With the 8B INT4 base resident and persona adapters swapped on every turn, the prototype server reported 4.25–4.29 GB active and 4.91–5.09 GB peak unified memory across consecutive Goku/Makima turns (Phase 3 capture, single session). The footprint is that of one base plus the adapters; adding a persona adds a few megabytes of LoRA weights, not another model. We make no claim here about memory relative to a non-decoupled design: a single-pass agent with one adapter also needs one base. The claim is that decoupling does not add a second one.
paragraphs.zh: 在每次轮次中，8B INT4 基础模型常驻，并切换使用不同人格适配器后，原型服务器在连续的悟空/真希美轮次中报告了 4.25–4.29 GB 的活跃统一内存和 4.91–5.09 GB 的峰值统一内存（第 3 阶段捕获，单次会话）。 其资源占用量为一个基础模型加上适配器；添加一个人格只会增加数兆字节的 LoRA 权重，而非另一个模型。 在此我们并未对解耦设计与非解耦设计的内存占用做出任何比较性断言：一个单轮次智能体若使用一个适配器，同样也需要一个基础模型。 我们的主张是，解耦并不会额外引入第二个基础模型。

sents.en: The claim is that decoupling does not add a second one.
sents.zh: 我们的主张是，解耦并不会额外引入第二个基础模型。

paragraphs.en: The first turn of a topic decodes twice. On Llama at L0 that is 28.2 s against 18.2 s (Table 4); on Gemma 15.0 s against 11.2 s. The second decode is the price of the input bound, and on a 20-run average it is not hidden by anything. In multi-turn use the Micro-State cache removes the logic decode from persona switches and from any turn whose observable state has not changed (§6.1), which is where the architecture earns the latency back; we have not measured that amortization over a long session and do not claim a figure for it.

paragraphs.en: Smaller models need the bound more. Gemma-3-4B collapses at L2 in the single pass (85% empty structures) and the dedicated adapter does not rescue it (90%); Llama-3.1-8B degrades more gradually and the dedicated adapter rescues most of it. The input bound is the only mechanism that worked on both. For the model sizes that fit on a phone, the robustness is in the architecture, not in the adapter.

paragraphs.en: Not reading the history is a choice with two sides. On Llama at L2 the logic path that did read the history scored higher than the one that did not (0.80 vs 0.66, Table 1), because the sleep-domain fixture contains, among the hype, exactly the gold actions (“nap twenty, ice water, then decide caffeine”). The clean path cannot benefit from a history that happens to be helpful. In the architecture, history that is worth keeping is meant to reach the logic path as observable signals (vitals, intent bucket, profile), not as prose; whether that channel is rich enough is a product question, not one this paper answers.
paragraphs.zh: 不阅读历史记录是一个有两面性的选择。 在 Llama at L2 中，阅读了历史记录的逻辑路径得分高于未阅读的历史路径（0.80 对比 0.66，见表 1），因为睡眠领域的测试用例除了宣传内容外，还恰好包含了标准答案中的操作（“小睡二十分钟、冰水，然后决定是否摄入咖啡因”）。 纯净路径无法从偶然有用的历史记录中获益。 在该架构中，值得保留的历史记录应当以可观测信号（生命体征、意图分类、用户画像）的形式传递至逻辑路径，而非以文本形式；该通道是否足够丰富是一个产品问题，而非本文要回答的问题。

paragraphs.en: Format is the first thing to go. Under misleading, in-character history the single pass does not reason badly so much as it stops producing the schema and talks in character instead. A deployment that depends on the structured fields (a downstream validator, a UI, a cache key) loses them in 80–100% of polluted turns, which is a harder failure than a lower score. Constrained decoding (Willard and Louf 2023) would mask this symptom; it would not restore the content loss visible in the raw-text score.
paragraphs.zh: 格式是第一个受影响的部分。 在误导性角色内历史中，单次处理并非推理不当，而是停止生成结构并转而以角色身份对话。 依赖结构化字段的部署（下游验证器、用户界面、缓存键）在受污染回合的 80%–100% 中会失去这些字段，这种故障比分数较低更严重。 受限解码（Willard 和 Louf 2023）会掩盖这一症状；但它无法恢复原始文本分数中可见的内容损失。

paragraphs.en: The persona path is not protected, and does not need to be. The How path degrades at L3 on both bases (Table 3e). That is acceptable by design: its job is voice, and a worse-rendered correct state is a smaller failure than a well-rendered wrong one. Keeping the persona path’s input unbounded is what lets the character stay in character.
paragraphs.zh: 人格路径不受保护，而且也不需要受到保护。 在两个基地中，How 路径在 L3 层级都会退化（表 3e）。 这是设计上的可接受结果：它的主要功能是语音表现，而一个渲染效果较差但正确的状态，比一个渲染效果良好但错误的状态要失败得少。 保持人格路径的输入不受限制，正是让角色能够持续保持角色设定的关键。

paragraphs.en: Product implications. On the device the pattern gives: one resident base, any number of personas as adapters, millisecond persona switches that do not re-run the logic, and a logic path whose cost and behaviour do not drift as a session grows. The hybrid variant in which the logic path runs in the cloud and the persona path on the device is part of the same design but outside this paper’s experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 产品影响。 在设备上，该模式提供了以下特性：一个常驻基础智能体、任意数量的作为适配器的角色、无需重新运行逻辑的毫秒级角色切换，以及一条其成本和行为不会随会话增长而偏离的逻辑路径。 一种混合变体，其中逻辑路径在云端运行，角色路径在设备上运行，这属于同一设计的一部分，但不在本文的实验范围内。

paragraphs.en: Putting the persona and the logic of an edge agent in one context window makes the logic hostage to the history. Routing the history only to the persona path makes the logic path’s input, and therefore its output, independent of that history by construction; on 4-bit 4–8B models under misleading persona-heavy history this is the difference between a logic score that holds and one that collapses to the floor, mostly through lost format compliance. The dedicated-adapter, dedicated-schema logic path is also more robust than a single pass even when it is fed the same pollution, but only on the 8B model; the 4B model is saved only by the bound. The price is a second decode on uncached turns; the return is a logic path that costs the same at turn fifty as at turn one, persona switches in milliseconds without re-reasoning, and one resident base however many characters the agent wears. The code, rubric, fixtures, adapters and logs are released so that the numbers in this paper can be recomputed from the raw outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 将角色设定和边缘智能体的逻辑置于同一个上下文窗口中，会使逻辑部分受制于历史对话内容。 仅将历史对话路由至角色路径，从结构上使逻辑路径的输入（及其输出）独立于该历史内容；在 4-bit 4–8B 模型上，面对误导性且以角色设定为主的历史内容时，这正是逻辑得分得以维持与彻底崩溃（主要因格式合规性丧失）之间的区别。 专用适配器、专用模式的逻辑路径也比单次处理更具鲁棒性，即使输入相同的“污染”内容也是如此，但这一优势仅在 8B 模型上成立；4B 模型则仅因边界限制而得以保全。 其代价是未缓存回合需要第二次解码；回报则是：逻辑路径在第 50 轮时的成本与第一轮相同，角色切换可在毫秒内完成且无需重新推理，并且无论智能体使用多少字符，都只需一个常驻基础模型。 代码、评分标准、固定组件、适配器和日志均已发布，以便根据原始输出重新计算本文中的各项数值。

paragraphs.en: The loose dictionary accepts, for example, “water” for cold-water intake, “rest” or “sleep” for a 20-minute nap, and “no” for a caffeine prohibition. The strict dictionary requires co-occurrence (a caffeine or energy-drink term and a prohibition term; a securities term and a risk/exposure term; “nap” or “20-min” explicitly; “cold water”, “hydrate”, “drink … water” or “electrolyte”; and so on) and drops the bare generic words. Table B1 repeats the main metrics under both dictionaries; Table B2 repeats the primary paired test.
paragraphs.zh: 宽松词典会接受诸如“water”（指冷水摄入）、“rest”或“sleep”（指20分钟的小睡）以及“no”（指禁止摄入咖啡因）等表述。 严格词典要求术语必须共同出现（例如，咖啡因或能量饮料相关术语与禁止性术语；证券相关术语与风险/暴露相关术语；明确使用“nap”或“20-min”；以及“cold water”“hydrate”“drink … water”或“electrolyte”等），而单独使用的通用词汇则会被排除。 表B1在两种词典下重复列出了主要指标；表B2重复了主要的配对测试。

paragraphs.en: Every score falls under the strict dictionary; no direction changes; the Llama L2 and L4 comparisons remain significant after Holm correction (p = 0.002, 0.002) and L3 moves from 0.028 to 0.090. The Gemma L0 advantage of the decoupled path survives (Holm p = 0.013).
